::: {.profile-bio}
I am an undergraduate in Applied Mathematics and Computer Science in the dual-degree program at [Duke Kunshan University](https://www.dukekunshan.edu.cn/) and [Duke University](https://duke.edu/).

My research interests include reliable machine learning, causal and counterfactual inference, graph and temporal learning, scientific machine learning, model auditing, and numerical verification.
:::
::::
